title: Private VM gateway renders the authenticated agent

requires.fixture: Only vm-proof-605 owned by vm-proof-owner, with a live generation and the isolated gateway route installed
requires.setup: scripts/vm-gateway-fixture.mjs browser GENERATION prepares a two-minute HttpOnly cookie from the backend-only synthetic credentials, navigates this exact origin via CDP, and executes these assertions. No real-user credentials or model calls. If the unconfigured synthetic agent shows .setup-modal, assert its Mapache Authentication Center notice and dismiss its .modal-close button before capturing the composer.
requires.cleanup: Remove the fixture cookie and close the harness-created page; stop only the fallback Chrome process started for this case. Leave fixture VM/data in place for replacement validation.

steps.expected: Agent body has visible text and a textarea or contenteditable message composer; Loading session has cleared, with no access-denied or startup-error page.

Main document and application bundles respond successfully; no unexpected failed HTTP requests or browser exceptions. The synthetic VM is not paired with an upstream Device Center hub: only GET /agent/api/device-center/shared-rooms returning 409 with body code NOT_PAIRED is expected. Other 409 responses fail.
